dict.string: We use your data to provide personalized content and measure performance. We ask for permission to track activity across apps and websites to support these features.

We use the camera so you can take a new photo to upload for community ratings and to generate your personal style analysis report. Example: Tap “Take New Photo” in Upload to capture and submit a photo.
We need access to your photo library to select photos for upload.
We need permission to save photos to your library when exporting or saving results.
